name: Bolton Vouched
maker: YSB Designs, a trading name of YSB Ventures Ltd
maturity: live today, with a pre-launch checklist still open

brand.tone: Warm, neighbourly and plain-spoken, written in British English and scrupulously honest about what is built, what is coming and what is never for sale.

facts.text: Bolton Vouched brings together local people, vouched for by Bolton.

source.quote: **Local people, vouched for by Bolton.**

facts.text: Bolton Vouched gathers the tradespeople that Bolton's WhatsApp group recommends in one place, alongside the checks that have been made on them.

source.quote: The tradespeople Bolton's WhatsApp group recommends, in one place, with the checks we've made.

facts.text: For Bolton residents who need a trusted tradesperson, it is free to use with no account and no sign-up.

source.quote: | **Residents** | Free. No account, no sign-up |

facts.text: For local tradespeople, a basic listing on Bolton Vouched is free, for good.

source.quote: | **A basic listing** | Free, for good |

facts.text: Good recommendations in the local WhatsApp group scroll away under hundreds of messages, so the next person has to ask all over again.

source.quote: Then they scroll away under a few hundred messages, and the next person asks again.

facts.text: Every week someone in the Bolton Tradesmen WhatsApp group asks whether anyone knows a good tradesperson.

source.quote: Every week someone in the Bolton Tradesmen WhatsApp group asks *"anyone know a good…?"*.

facts.text: A directory of tradespeople's mobile numbers is exactly what spammers and scrapers want, and traders who get cold-called will not stay listed.

source.quote: A directory of tradespeople's mobile numbers is exactly what spammers and scrapers want

facts.text: Nobody can pay to move up the list, and that promise is the heart of the product.

source.quote: **Nobody can pay to move up the list.** That sentence is the product.
